title: Rebus
description: A simple and robust service bus implementation for .NET.

data.text: Rebus is a simple and robust service bus implementation for .NET. It is designed to be easy to set up and use, with a focus on convention over configuration and minimal ceremony.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install Rebus and the RabbitMQ transport.
data.code:
dotnet add package Rebus
dotnet add package Rebus.RabbitMq

data.title: Sending and Handling Messages

terms.definition: An architectural pattern for decoupled communication between services.
A class that processes messages of a specific type.

data.title: Simplicity
data.text: Rebus emphasizes simplicity and convention over configuration, making it great for smaller services.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Rebus is lightweight and easy to configure
data.takeaway: Rebus is a pragmatic choice for simple, reliable service bus implementations.
